stories.title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
stories.summary: Broadcom has shipped patches to address 23 vulnerabilities impacting VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer, including one critical bug that could be abused to bypass authentication. stories.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites
stories.summary: The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday.

stories.title: Drupal Fail2Install Exploit Details Emerge as Critical RCE Flaw Faces Active Exploitation
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added a critical flaw impacting Drupal to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, requiring federal agencies to apply the fixes by November 27, 2026. stories.title: Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday added two flaws impacting N-able MailAssure and MONAI Label to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. stories.title: Hackers Exploit Two GeoServer Flaws as Researchers Warn of Unauthenticated RCE Chains
stories.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting two newly patched security flaws in GeoServer, according to watchTowr. stories.title: InfraTrust warns of exploited supply chain flaws in network appliances
stories.summary: Eclypsium's November InfraTrust report warns that most infrastructure security advisories addressing exploited vulnerabilities over the past month involve flaws in third-party software bundled into products rather than code developed by the vendors themselves.

stories.title: Hackers Found a Way Around GitHub SHA Pinning. This Webinar Explains How to Close the Gap
stories.summary: Pinning GitHub Actions to an exact version of their code, known as SHA pinning, has become the go-to defense against software supply chain attacks. Attackers have already found a way around it. stories.title: Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack
stories.summary: Attackers are probing GeoServer instances for two high-severity flaws that can be chained with other bugs for unauthenticated RCE.
